title: Elsa Neumann Doctoral Scholarship

provider.name: State of Berlin / participating Berlin universities

summary: Doctoral support under Berlin's young-researcher funding framework for German and international candidates with strong academic results.

degree_levels.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

subject_areas.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

institutions.notes: Doctoral candidates must be enrolled and supervised at one of the four participating Berlin universities.

nationality.notes: The university explicitly describes German and international doctoral candidates.

residence.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

mandatory.text: Doctoral study within the participating Berlin university scheme.
Exceptional academic achievement, particularly in the university degree.
Enrolment and supervision at a participating Berlin university are required.
The same doctoral project must not already have received public funding; annual progress reports and supervisor statements apply to continuing full awards.

funding.description: EUR 1,350 monthly base plus EUR 100 monthly research-cost allowance. Family supplements and travel-cost reimbursement can be requested. Full-time awards last up to 36 months; final-stage completion awards last at most 12 months and cannot be extended.
funding.duration: Full-time doctoral scholarship: up to 36 months. Completion award: at most 12 months, non-extendable.

application_rounds.notes: No confirmed application dates were established.

TU Berlin states 16 September–11 November 2026, noon; central DRS confirms the November deadline and earliest funding start 1 April 2027. The timezone is not explicit, so the noon clock time remains descriptive.

recurring_deadline_notes: The overview lists April for funding starting in July and October for funding starting in April; exact year-specific dates require the current call.

steps.text: Read the detailed Center for Junior Scholars information and current call.
Apply through the stated university process.
